solutionSql:
WITH distinct_weights AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, weight_kg
  FROM shipments
  WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         weight_kg,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY weight_kg DESC) AS rnk
  FROM distinct_weights
)
SELECT customer_id,
       weight_kg AS second_weight
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 2
ORDER BY customer_id;
notes: Revised text states integer types. The SQL was unchanged and already returns integer for customer_id and second_weight (OID 23), so no cast was needed. DENSE_RANK() over distinct (customer_id, weight_kg) pairs, NULL weights removed first, keeping rank 2. Sample customer 1 gives 1986 (maximum 1999); customer 2 gives 1828 (maximum 1894).
